about: Reviewed defaults of discover_indicators (AQ-04A), moved out of the discovery code. They apply to tool discovery only: concept_search, the catalogue search and the UI never read this file. Rules name concepts, phrases and datasets that already exist; services/tools/discovery_policy.py validates them when loaded and against concepts.json and recipes.json, and a rule whose concept is absent is inert (it assumes nothing). `phrase` is put in front of the question and must be a specific alias of its concept. `terms` are the words by which a question names a definition itself (a trailing * is any ending); a definition named by one of its specific aliases counts too. A question that names a definition never gets a default.
